entities.name: Kunoros
entities.description: Three-headed cerberus, Hound of Athreos, guardian dog of the god Athreos who guards the Underworld on Theros.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God on Theros whose guardian dog is Kunoros.

entities.name: Kroxa
entities.description: Titan of death's hunger who devours Phyrexians in the Underworld.

entities.name: The Underworld
entities.description: Realm on Theros guarded by Kunoros.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: Phyrexian tree whose branches pierced into the Underworld.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invading forces who compleat all they touch.

events.summary: The Invasion Tree's branches pierce the Underworld and Phyrexian forces march through, compleating all they touch.
events.quote: the branches of the Invasion Tree pierced into the Underworld itself

events.summary: Kroxa devours the Phyrexians so thoroughly that no trace remains.
events.quote: who devoured them so thoroughly that no trace of them remained

events.summary: Athreos strikes Kroxa's chains and sets him loose within the Underworld.
events.quote: Athreos chose to strike Kroxa's chains and set him loose within the Underworld

events.summary: Athreos charges Kunoros with keeping Kroxa in check so it cannot escape to the mortal realm.
events.quote: Athreos charged Kunoros with keeping him in check

relations.note: Kunoros is the guardian dog of Athreos.
relations.quote: is the guardian dog of the god Athreos on Theros
who devoured them so thoroughly that no trace of them remained
